title: Tillu, The Monkey Who Loved Bananas
description: Tillu, a mischievous monkey, goes on a hilarious adventure to find the world's biggest banana, learning teamwork and kindness along the way.

scenes.description: wide shot of sunny jungle morning with Tillu hanging upside down from a tree
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) sunny green jungle morning, Tillu the mischievous monkey hanging upside down from branch, birds chirping, storybook funny style:1.4
scenes.narration: सुबह-सुबह टिल्लू पेड़ की टहनी से उल्टा लटककर सोच रहा था कि आज क्या मस्ती की जाए।
scenes.subtitle: Monkey Mischief

scenes.description: close-up of Tillu sniffing a giant banana poster
scenes.visual_prompt: close-up of Tillu the mischievous monkey sniffing a colorful poster of world's biggest banana, silly expression, storybook comic style
scenes.narration: अचानक उसे एक पोस्टर दिखा — दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा केला! बस, टिल्लू ने ठान लिया, यही चाहिए!
scenes.subtitle: Banana Dream

scenes.description: medium shot of Tillu asking Golu the bear for help
scenes.visual_prompt: medium shot of Tillu the mischievous monkey talking to Golu the lazy but clever bear lying on hammock, jungle background, playful expressions, storybook humor style
scenes.narration: टिल्लू ने अपने आलसी दोस्त गोलू से कहा — ‘चलो खजाने की खोज पर!’
scenes.subtitle: Recruiting Golu

scenes.description: wide shot of Tillu, Golu, and Pinky walking through jungle with a hand-drawn map
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) Tillu the mischievous monkey, Golu the lazy bear, and Pinky the fast-talking squirrel walking with crumpled hand-drawn map, lush jungle background, storybook adventure style:1.4
scenes.narration: गोलू और पिंकी गिलहरी भी टीम में शामिल हो गए, और मस्ती भरी खोज शुरू हो गई।
scenes.subtitle: Banana Quest Begins

scenes.description: medium shot of Pinky chattering excitedly and pointing at a banana-shaped cloud
scenes.visual_prompt: medium shot of Pinky the fast-talking squirrel pointing at banana-shaped cloud in sky, Tillu the mischievous monkey and Golu the bear laughing, bright jungle background, storybook funny style
scenes.subtitle: Banana in the Sky

scenes.description: wide shot of friends crossing a wobbly rope bridge over a river
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) Tillu the mischievous monkey, Golu the bear, and Pinky the squirrel crossing wobbly rope bridge over sparkling river, exaggerated funny movements, storybook comic style:1.4
scenes.narration: तीनों ने पुल पार किया, लेकिन टिल्लू बीच में ही केले के सपने देखने लगा।
scenes.subtitle: Bridge of Giggles

scenes.description: medium shot of Tillu finding a giant golden banana in a clearing
scenes.visual_prompt: medium shot of Tillu the mischievous monkey holding giant golden banana with sparkle effects, amazed expression, jungle clearing, storybook magical style
scenes.narration: आखिरकार, उन्हें सुनहरी केला मिल गया!
scenes.subtitle: Golden Banana Found

scenes.description: wide shot of all animals sharing the banana together in jungle
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) Tillu the monkey, Golu the bear, Pinky the squirrel, and other jungle animals sharing giant banana, laughing and happy, storybook friendship style:1.4
scenes.narration: टिल्लू ने तय किया कि केला सबके साथ बांटा जाएगा।
scenes.subtitle: Banana Feast

scenes.description: close-up of Tillu with banana peel on his head, making a silly face
scenes.visual_prompt: close-up of Tillu the mischievous monkey wearing banana peel as hat, making silly face, bright jungle background, storybook comic style
scenes.narration: और फिर, टिल्लू ने छिलके को टोपी बना लिया।
scenes.subtitle: Banana Hat

scenes.description: wide shot of sunset in jungle with friends resting together
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) jungle at sunset, Tillu the monkey, Golu the bear, and Pinky the squirrel resting happily, warm golden light, storybook peaceful style:1.4
scenes.narration: दिन का अंत हंसी, दोस्ती और केले के मीठे स्वाद के साथ हुआ।
scenes.subtitle: Sweet Ending
